# Sergey Fedorov

> System administration, IT infrastructure, networking, CCTV and VoIP. The portfolio also covers automation and AI tools.

## Public profile

- [Visible profile](https://fedorovserhii.github.io/Portfolio/#profile): Profile facts, skills, service scopes and public contacts.
- [JSON profile](https://fedorovserhii.github.io/Portfolio/profile.json): The same profile in English, Russian, Ukrainian and Polish.
- [Markdown profile](https://fedorovserhii.github.io/Portfolio/profile.md): A readable copy of those profile facts in all four languages.
